The company has market cap of $2.29 billion. The Company’s Sterling Jewelers division operates stores in malls and off-mall locations primarily under the Kay Jewelers, Kay Jewelers Outlet, Jared The Galleria Of Jewelry, Jared Vault, and various mall regional brands. It has a 5.22 P/E ratio. As of January 28, 2017, this division operated 1,588 stores.
